content: Kut kithi mipa inkhat
Khan Jesu ning Synagogue aleikirnok, khawa khan akut kithi miring inkhat aleiom.
Jesu ning akidikmak atho tia akitinom mi alek khawakhan anleiom; khawa jarra Jehudi Serni kini khan amaning mipa kha amindam sikmi tia akatha anlei ensui.
Jesu ning mipa deng aleiti,
Khan amaning mi ngaideng aleirakal,

content.text: <<Jehudi Serni kini khan eini Senadan ning angmo tho atha ati e? Sansik mi a-imakli akathamak tho sikmi? Mi inkhat ringkho sansik a-imakli minmang sik mi?>>

content: Takkha anmanining ite leirilmuk.
Jesu ning amit alei kiwella anmanideng alei enna aleirang, tak anmani sik mulung leihoipui mak, ajarchu anmani mulung kanger le anthamak jarra aleipongpui. Khawasoli amaning mipa dengkhan aleiti,
Amaning akut aheikeiso a, khan akutkha amasa anga aleidam.
Khawa jarra Pharisees ngaining Synagogue anmathaanna anleise khan Herod mi alek ngaile kinnot a ankinmu a, anmanining Jesu thatnasik sin anleikinthok.
Tuitham panga mipuingai
Jesu ning athiemroi ngaile Galilee tuitham teng anleise, khan mipui katamtak ning anuk anleijui. Anmani ngaikha Galilee, Judea ria anleihong,
Jerusalem, Idumea, Jordan nisotenga, khan Tyre le Sidon khopui asir-apang ria anhong kinphut. Hiwa mirikip ngaihi Jesu deng anleihong ajarchu amaning atho ngaikha anleijet.
Mipui antamhei jarra ama an-uum maknasik Jesu ning athiemroi ngaideng rukuong inkhat amasik rathok ru aleiti.
Amaning mi katamtak aleimindam, khan akana rikip ning ama kotok nasik anlei kin et-tarpui ama omnateng anlei nai.
Khan Ratha kathamak kulut mirikip ning ama anmu karkhan, anmani ning amaikunga anleipur khan anlei-ong, <<Nangchu Pathien Sapa kha ni-e!>>
Jesu ning ratha kathamak kulut anmani ngaideng ama atu mi tihi atu inkhat deng rilmuru tia chong kangertak aleipe.
Jesu ning tirle somle-inni akadang
Khan Jesu ning chingmuol chunga akalla khan amaning amonom mi ngaikha aleikoi. Anmani ning amadeng anheiwo a,
khan amaning somle-inni ngaikha aleikadang, tirle tia aleipho. <<Kei le akaom sik a nangnihi kanakadang ejei,>> amaning anmanideng aleiti. <<Keining nangni chongkiril sik a kunumuso sik,
Khan khori ngai holsuok nasik ranak ninnei sik.>>
Hiwa senghi amaning akadang somle-inni ngaikha an e: Simon, Jesu ning Peter tia ariming apho;
James le anaipa John, Zebedee ngai naite, Jesu ning Boanerges tia ariming aleipho, hiwa tinachu <<Rokinri Mi>>
Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James Alphaeus sapa, Thaddaeus, khan Canan ria Simon,
Khan mi khutchunga akapesuok sikpa Judas Iscariot, hiwa ngaihi an e.
Jesu le Beelzebul
Khan Jesu inn teng aleise. Mipui akatamtak anhong kinchun nok a Jesu le athiemroi ngaikha bubak nasik pha leinei muk.
Ama insung mi ngaining hiwa chong anjetkarra, anmani ning amakha roisuok nasik anleitho, ajarchu mipui ning anleiti, <<Amahi akinwetjei!>>
Jerusalem teng ria akahong Dan Oja alek ngaining anleiti, <<Ama sunga Beelzebul aom! Anmani holsuok nasik amadeng ranak akape kha khori ngai lukakeipa e.>>
Khawa jarra Jesu ning anmani ngaikha akolla akoi-a khan anmanideng chongtekak ngaikha aleirilpe: <<Seitan ning kho-ongmo seitan aholsuok tor sik?
Rengram inkhat ning ankin khoithenna rupni ansuokli inkhatle inkhat ankinsol inchu, khawa rengram kha akoisik e.
Insung inkhat akin khoithenna rupni ansuokli inkhatle inkhat ankinsol inchu, khawa insung kha akoisik e.
Khawa jarra Seitan rengram hi rupni suok a ankin khoithen inchu, khawakha sotno ning, takkha koi ata ahekna amang ripsik e.
<<Tu inkhat ningnum akarat mipakha ankhit masa a adamak inchu; a-inna lutli neinak rikip kha khektor nonung. Kha inchu mipa kha ankhit masa inchu neinak kha ankhektor sik.
<<Akidik a keining nangnideng kiti hi e, khachu mi ngai setna le akathamak rikip anril angjet aleiom inum rangaimindam pesik e.
Takkha atu inum Ratha Kintheng chunga akirildek ngaikha angtikkar inum rangaimindam penoning, ajarchu amaning kumleiko setna athojei.>>
<<Ama sunga ratha kathamak kha aom>> mi alek ning anti jarra, Jesu ning hiwahi aleiti.
Jesu anu le anaingai
Khan Jesu anu le anaingai anhongtung. Anmani ning inn tolla anngirra khan ama kinmu pui sik a chong anlei muso.
Jesu akolla mipui katamtak anlei kin ong, khan anmani ning amadeng anleiti, <<Enro, nunu le nu-u nanai, naser ngaining tolla nang ana kinmu puinom a an om.>>
Jesu ning aleimasang, <<Atumi kei kunu? Atumi kei ku-u kanai ngai?>>
Ama akolla akin-ong mipui ngaikha ahei enna aleiti, <<Enru! Hinna akaom ngaihi kei kunu le ku-u kanai ngaikha an e!
Atu-tu inum Pathien lungdo kutho ngaikha ku-u, kanai, kunu le kaser ngaikha an e.>>
